caption: The video showcases a close-up of an open hand, four fingers extended upward against a blurred light-gray pavement. A three-stone ring sits on the middle finger, its round central diamond held in a six-prong setting. Two smaller side stones flank the center on a band paved with tiny clear stones, while pink polish tints a fingertip. The central stone repeatedly catches the light, throwing specular flashes and yellow, green, and blue-violet flare bursts that bloom and fade. A slight rocking tilts the hand, shifting the viewing angle of the diamond and the visibility of the side stones. The framing drifts marginally, revealing a second polished nail at the upper edge of the rightmost finger. Between the sparkles the hand stays raised, the flashes being reflections on the gem.
relations: Slight rocking changes the diamond's viewing angle, causing specular flashes and colored flares to bloom and fade.
As the hand tilts, visibility of the side stones and paved band shifts relative to the light.
The hand stays raised between sparkles, keeping the ring positioned on the middle finger.
Marginal framing drift reveals a second polished nail at the upper edge of the rightmost finger.
